presentation.name: Drummer
presentation.subtitle: Human in command
presentation.revision: A front door rebuilt from the ground up: one gate, seven stations, the captain decides.

statement: V44 Drummer rebuilds the front door around a live transit gate and seven stations in the platinum cAshIo identity. The gate is generative artwork. The helm and E.V.E. are scripted browser experiences that send no requests. Observation records and historical releases retain their original dates, versions and limits.
